description: JWT lint: alg none, crit, key-URL headers, expiry, audience (decode only) — Decodes a compact JWT (never verifies the signature) and checks it against RFC 7519 and RFC 8725 for an agent about to trust or forward it: alg none or missing, crit and key-supplying headers (jku, x5u, jwk), kid injection shape, duplicate claims, and exp, nbf, iat against a caller-supplied time, plus optional expected algorithms, issuer and audience. Without asOf the time claims are not judged an

asOf.description: Reference instant, epoch seconds. Required to judge exp/nbf/iat.

expectedAlgs.description: Allow-list of algorithms; any other alg fails.

requireExp.description: Default true: a token without exp fails.

name: jwt-lint
